properties.NAME: KNOX (Ind.)
properties.CHANGE: KNOX (Ind.) gained non-county area in Indiana Terr; included part of present Ohio. KNOX (Ind.) also lost to creation of CLARK (Ind.), & lost to RANDOLPH (Ill.) & ST. CLAIR (Ill.); KNOX (Ind.) included territory in present Ind., Ohio, Ill., and Mich.
properties.CITATION: (Ind. Terr., Exec. Journal, 97-100; Pence and Armstrong, 212, 520)
